gloss: pod; shell; hull (of beans or peas)

definitions.explanation: The outer casing of legumes such as peas, beans, and edamame that encloses the seeds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{枝豆|えだまめ}→枝豆：21197_edamame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{莢|さや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むく。
{莢|さや}ごと⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some beans can be eaten pod and all.

examples.japanese: {莢|さや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らんで→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なったら→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だ。
examples.english: When the pods swell and the beans inside grow large, it's time to harvest.

notes:
Written with the kanji {莢|さや} (the grass radical indicates it is plant-related). This word appears frequently in cooking and gardening contexts. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{鞘|さや}→鞘：14698_saya⟧ (sheath/scabbard for a blade).

Many common Japanese vegetables include {莢|さや} in their names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {莢|さや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧むく: to shell pods
- {莢|さや}ごと: pod and all; with the pod
- {莢|さや}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to remove from the pod

COMPOUNDS:
- {莢|さや}{豌豆|えんどう}: snow peas; snap peas
- {莢|さや}{隠元|いんげん}: string beans; green beans (with pods)
- {莢|さや}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with pods still on

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鞘|さや}→鞘：14698_saya⟧: sheath; scabbard (for swords or knives — different kanji, same reading)
- ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: shell; husk (for nuts, eggs, shellfish)
